title: Perturbed Families of Symmetric Interval Exchange Maps
summary: A perturbed family of interval exchange maps (FIEMs) provides a natural two-\linebreak{}dimensional area-preserving extension of interval exchange maps, with each IEM parameterized by an action variable $y$. Such families arise, for example, as models for iso-energy return maps of perturbed pseudointegrable Hamiltonian impact systems. These maps inherit a time-reversal symmetry, motivating the study of symmetric FIEMs. In the unperturbed case, the dynamics are generically uniquely ergodic for almost every value of $y$, while a dense set of action values supports periodic intervals.…
